item.text: I’ve got a clean utility-level cut: centralize Termux package-context lookup and the app-info section formatting/fallback logic in `TermuxUtils`, then switch the public wrappers and app-info branches over to those helpers. That improves structure without changing any outward API.

The utility refactor is in. I’m checking the touched `TermuxUtils` paths now for any behavioral drift, especially the `TERMUX_AND_CALLING_PACKAGE` branch where plugin contexts and fallback markdown were previously interleaved.

The `TermuxUtils` refactor is coherent so far. I’m doing one last targeted search to make sure the direct package-context lookups inside the app-info code paths are actually gone, not just moved around.

**Findings**
- Low to medium: `TermuxUtils` still had repeated Termux package-context lookup and duplicated app-info markdown composition logic. The duplication was spread across both the public package-context wrappers and the `TERMUX_AND_CALLING_PACKAGE` / plugin-app info branches.

I refactored that into shared private helpers in [TermuxUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/TermuxUtils.java:55): `getPackageContext(...)`, `getInstalledTermuxPluginPackageContext(...)`, `appendAppInfoSection(...)`, and `getCallingPackageAppInfoMarkdownString(...)`. The public wrappers now route through the shared context helper, and the app-info paths use the shared plugin-context fallback and section formatting instead of rebuilding those decisions inline. The main behavioral simplifications are in [TermuxUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/TermuxUtils.java:397) and [TermuxUtils.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/TermuxUtils.java:425).

Static verification shows the direct package-context lookups are gone from those app-info branches and now flow through the shared helpers instead. I still could not run a build or tests because `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` is missing and `gradle` is not installed in this workspace.
